cards.ex: She really fulfilled expectations in her new role as CEO.
cards.exUz: U yangi bosh direktor lavozimida umidlarni rostdan ham oqladi.
cards.uzDef: Birov kutgan narsalarni to'liq bajarmoq, ularning ishonchini qondirmoq.

cards.ex: That new technology is a real game changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy o'zgarish yasovchi narsa.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni butunlay o'zgartirib yuboradigan narsa yoki voqea.

cards.ex: He won the award, but he didn't rest on his laurels and kept working hard.
cards.exUz: U mukofotni oldi, lekin dam olib yotmadi va qattiq ishlashni davom ettirdi.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi muvaffaqiyatlar bilan kifoyalanib, yangi harakat qilmaslik.

cards.ex: Her story is about triumph over adversity; she overcame so much.
cards.exUz: Uning hikoyasi qiyinchilikni yengish haqida; u juda ko'p narsani yengib o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklar va muammolarni yengib, g'alaba qozonmoq.

cards.ex: The company is always ahead of the curve when it comes to innovation.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya innovatsiyalar masalasida doimo oldingi qatorda turadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan oldinda bo'lish, yangiliklardan xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: After years of hard work, she finally reached the pinnacle of her career.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik mehnatdan so'ng, u nihoyat o'z karerasining cho'qqisiga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yuqori darajaga, eng katta muvaffaqiyatga yetmoq.

cards.ex: The team is on a roll; they've won five games in a row.
cards.exUz: Jamoaning omadi kelyapti; ular ketma-ket beshta o'yinda g'alaba qozonishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ketma-ket muvaffaqiyatga erishish, omadli davrda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new restaurant was a roaring success from day one.
cards.exUz: Yangi restoran birinchi kundan boshlab katta muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va sezilarli muvaffaqiyat.

cards.ex: The movie lived up to all the hype; it was fantastic.
cards.exUz: Film barcha shov-shuvlarga loyiq edi; u ajoyib edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan darajada yoki undan ham yaxshiroq bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's really mastered the art of negotiation; she always gets a good deal.
cards.exUz: U muzokaralar olib borish san'atini chindan ham egallagan; u doimo yaxshi kelishuvga erishadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani mukammal o'rganib, mohir bo'lish.

cards.ex: He went from zero to hero in just one year with his innovative ideas.
cards.exUz: U o'zining innovatsion g'oyalari bilan bir yil ichida nol'dan qahramonga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Hech kim bo'lmasdan, tezda muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.

cards.ex: She's determined to make her mark in the world of science.
cards.exUz: U ilm-fan olamida o'z izini qoldirishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada o'zining muhim rolini o'ynamoq, taniqli bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Starting early gave him a head start in his career.
cards.exUz: Erta boshlash unga o'z karerasida oldinga sakrash imkonini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan oldin boshlash, afzallikka ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Their new product was a breakthrough success, exceeding all expectations.
cards.exUz: Ularning yangi mahsuloti kutilganidan ham oshib ketgan ulkan muvaffaqiyat edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan va katta muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: Winning this award is another feather in their cap.
cards.exUz: Ushbu mukofotni yutish ularning yana bir faxrli yutug'idir.
cards.uzDef: Qilingan ish uchun faxrlanishga arziydigan muvaffaqiyat.

cards.ex: He's on the fast track to becoming a partner at the firm.
cards.exUz: U firmada sherik bo'lishning tezkor yo'lida.
cards.uzDef: Tez rivojlanish yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishish yo'lida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Their new strategy helped turn the tide and improve sales.
cards.exUz: Ularning yangi strategiyasi vaziyatni o'zgartirishga va sotuvni yaxshilashga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni yaxshi tomonga o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: He clinched the deal with his persuasive presentation.
cards.exUz: U o'zining ishonchli taqdimoti bilan kelishuvga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralar natijasida kelishuvga erishish, bitimni yakunlash.

cards.ex: She's at the top of her game right now; she's winning every competition.
cards.exUz: U hozir o'zining eng yuqori cho'qqisida; u har bir musobaqada g'alaba qozonmoqda.
cards.term: at the top of one's game
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi natijalarni ko'rsatayotgan, eng yuqori darajada bo'lish.

cards.ex: His entrepreneurial journey is a true success story.
cards.exUz: Uning tadbirkorlik yo'li haqiqiy muvaffaqiyat hikoyasidir.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarni yengib o'tib, muvaffaqiyatga erishgan shaxs yoki loyiha haqidagi hikoya.

cards.ex: Their performance has raised the bar for the entire industry.
cards.exUz: Ularning ishlashi butun sanoat uchun talabni oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Standartlarni yuqoriroq darajaga ko'tarish, yaxshiroq natijalarni talab qilish.

cards.ex: They made a killing on the stock market last year.
cards.exUz: Ular o'tgan yili fond bozorida katta foyda olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda katta miqdorda pul topmoq.

cards.ex: She always goes above and beyond to help her colleagues.
cards.exUz: U doimo hamkasblariga yordam berish uchun ortig'ini qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Talab qilinganidan ko'proq harakat qilmoq, juda mehribonlik ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: After winning the lottery, he was finally living the dream.
cards.exUz: Lotereyada yutib olgandan so'ng, u nihoyat orzu bilan yashay boshladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining orzusidagi hayotni yashamoq, xohlagan narsasiga erishmoq.

cards.ex: Her career really took off after she published her first book.
cards.exUz: Uning karerasi birinchi kitobini nashr etgandan so'ng, haqiqatan ham rivojlanib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanish, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: Even when things got tough, she stayed the course and achieved her goals.
cards.exUz: Ishlar qiyinlashganda ham, u yo'lda qoldi va o'z maqsadlariga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, maqsadga erishish uchun harakat qilishni davom ettirish.

cards.ex: The new marketing strategy worked like a charm and increased sales significantly.
cards.exUz: Yangi marketing strategiyasi juda yaxshi ishladi va sotuvni sezilarli darajada oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi ishlash, muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish.

cards.ex: After a long review process, the project finally got the nod from the board.
cards.exUz: Uzoq ko'rib chiqish jarayonidan so'ng, loyiha nihoyat kengashdan ma'qullash oldi.
cards.uzDef: Tasdiqlash, ma'qullash yoki ruxsat olish.

cards.ex: The new play went down a storm with the audience.
cards.exUz: Yangi spektakl tomoshabinlar tomonidan juda yaxshi qabul qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Juda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish, hamma tomonidan yaxshi qabul qilinish.

cards.ex: With her talent and drive, she's destined for success.
cards.exUz: Uning iste'dodi va intilishi bilan, u muvaffaqiyatga mahkum.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga erishishi aniq bo'lgan odam.
